semantic_extensions.carrier: Normalized Model 2.4 metadata.semantic_extensions under its existing open metadata schema
semantic_extensions.key: stable semantic_field_key scoped by semantic-unit identity
semantic_extensions.value: complete typed JSON value without coercion
semantic_extensions.equality: key and complete typed value participate
semantic_extensions.duplicates: do not duplicate values already placed in a first-class normalized field
semantic_extensions.child_units: child semantic fields remain on child units; parent carries membership/identity only

direct_semantic_value.rule: Preserve the exact typed source value at its exact normalized semantic destination; when no first-class destination exists use metadata.semantic_extensions[stable key].

canonical_field_placement.rule: Map the exact source field to the named normalized semantic destination without loss or change of value meaning.

compatibility_projection.rule: Project only an explicitly enumerated source relation into a normalized compatibility record. Equality uses relationship meaning/type, owner scope when material, resolved endpoint UUIDs, authored semantic properties, and multiplicity.

declared_absence.rule: Only an explicit absence record names the source semantic unit/field selector, absent normalized concept/location, and governing rule.

deterministic_ceremony.rule: A representation-only value with no independent authored choice, uniquely derived from exact contract identity, established identity, fixed detached constants, and sealed basis.

aggregation.exactly_once: Each semantic unit is aggregated once by canonical UUIDv7 or governed owner-local identity; an embedded child remains its own unit and is not recounted from candidate_artifacts.
aggregation.standalone_fragments: Remain native roots and are interpreted without synthetic ADR wrapping.
aggregation.mixed_roots: Union all document-root and standalone-root units by canonical identity; duplicate identities fail closed.
aggregation.relationships: Canonical relationships match by UUIDv7; compatibility relationships match by their AI-declared semantic tuple with multiplicity; composition-derived relationships are emitted only by the declared topology rule.
aggregation.unresolved: Preserve as explicit unresolved semantic state; never turn unavailable or unresolved interpretation into success.

ordering_and_multiplicity.default: Arrays have no semantic order solely because they are JSON arrays. Unless a field entry or exact source authority declares order, canonicalize as an unordered multiset and preserve duplicate multiplicity.
ordering_and_multiplicity.identity_keyed_sets: Collections of canonical identity-bearing child units match by identity; duplicate identity rejects.
ordering_and_multiplicity.source_declared_sequence: ADR-root child-fragment sequences preserve order where Authoring Domain 1.1 declares source_declared_sequence.
ordering_and_multiplicity.owner_declared_sequence: Topology component values preserve the owner-declared sequence.
ordered_values: entity/data_flow#/path is an ordered owner-local topology-key path.
ordering_and_multiplicity.compatibility: Compatibility projections are unordered multisets; duplicate semantic tuples remain multiplicity-significant.

identity.compatibility: owner UUID when required + relationship type + resolved endpoint UUIDs + authored semantic properties + occurrence multiplicity

semantic_equality: authored source values under the field inventory
custom qualification that defines custom meaning
owner-local topology key and semantic occurrence distinction
candidate_integrity_not_equality: exact source bytes and content digest
source schema selector and resource qualification
provenance.source_semantics_rule: metadata.source_semantics is replay/provenance evidence, never proof of semantic preservation; it cannot satisfy a missing semantic extension or normalized destination.

normative_proposition_lifecycle_free.rule: Declaration-only normative propositions have no lifecycle. This is the only declared absence in this resource.

custom_semantics.entities: Require exact CEC 1.0 qualification; preserve UUIDv7 identity, semantic_type, consumer_namespace, contract_version, contract_fingerprint, and all qualified properties.
custom_semantics.relationships: Require exact relationship qualification and resolved UUID endpoints; preserve authored properties and multiplicity.
